verdict.rationale: Machine-to-machine credentials are a fair question for an auth product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents an OAuth client-credentials grant or any way to issue service or agent credentials. Self-signed JWTs via an imported signing key, third-party provider JWTs, and anonymous sign-ins are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue machine-to-machine credentials (client-credentials flow) so backend services and agents authenticate without a human in the loop
